```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-explorer-setup
//| output: false

import { clusterLinelist, cutoff, cutoffDisplay } from "_data.qmd"
// cutoffDate & cutoffDisplay globally availale from _ojs_setup.qmd

ceData = aq.table(clusterLinelist)

// All unique cluster IDs
ceAllIds = ceData
  .dedupe("cluster_id")
  .array("cluster_id")
  .sort()

// ID of clusters with ≥1 sequence since cutoff for "active cluster" filter
ceActiveIds = ceData
  .filter(aq.escape(d => d.date_onset >= cutoff))
  .dedupe("cluster_id")
  .array("cluster_id")
  .sort()

// Cluster size (count) lookup
ceSizeLookup = Object.fromEntries(
  ceData
  .groupby("cluster_id")
  .count()
  .objects()
  .map(d => [d.cluster_id, d.count])
)

// Lookup for acquisition & exposure. Easier in loop than Arquero
ceAcqExpLookup = {
  const attrs = {}
  for (const row of ceData.objects()) {
    if (!attrs[row.cluster_id]) attrs[row.cluster_id] = { acq: new Set(), exp: new Set() }
    if (row.acquisition_location) attrs[row.cluster_id].acq.add(row.acquisition_location)
    if (row.exposure_category) attrs[row.cluster_id].exp.add(row.exposure_category)
  }
  return attrs
}

// Unique values for checkbox filters
ceAcqValues = ceData
  .dedupe("acquisition_location")
  .array("acquisition_location")
  .sort()

ceExpValues = ceData
  .dedupe("exposure_category")
  .array("exposure_category")
  .sort()

// Lookup id to last sample date for "samples since" filter
ceLastDateLookup = Object.fromEntries(
  ceData
    .groupby("cluster_id")
    .rollup({last: d => op.max(d.date_onset)}).objects()
    .map(d => [d.cluster_id, new Date(d.last)])
)

```

# Cluster Explorer

## {.sidebar width="375px"}

**Filter clusters:**
<!-- <br/>
<span style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #666; font-style: italic;">
  <strong>Active:</strong> ≥1 sequence since ${cutoffDisplay}.<br/>
  <strong>Large:</strong> ≥10 sequences.
</span> -->

```{ojs}
viewof ceFilters = Inputs.form({
  activeOnly: Inputs.toggle({ label: "Active clusters only", value: true }),
  largeOnly: Inputs.toggle({ label: "Large clusters only", value: true }),
  samplesSince: Inputs.date({ label: "With samples since", value: "2019-01-01" }),
  acqFilter: Inputs.checkbox(
    ceAcqValues,
    { value: ceAcqValues, label: "Including acquisition:" }
  ),
  expFilter: Inputs.checkbox(
    ceExpValues,
    { value: ceExpValues, label: "Including exposure:" }
  )
})
```


```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-explorer-apply-filters
//| output: false

ceIdsFiltered = {
  const { activeOnly, largeOnly, samplesSince, acqFilter, expFilter } = ceFilters

  // Active filter
  let clusters = activeOnly ? ceActiveIds : ceAllIds

  // Size filter
  if (largeOnly) {
    clusters = clusters.filter(c => ceSizeLookup[c] >= 10)
  }

  // Last sample filter
  clusters = clusters.filter(c => ceLastDateLookup[c] >= samplesSince)

  // Acquisition & Exposure filter
  const acqSet = new Set(acqFilter)
  const expSet = new Set(expFilter)

  clusters = clusters.filter(c => {
    const attr = ceAcqExpLookup[c]
    if (!attr) return false
    const acqMatch = [...attr.acq].some(v => acqSet.has(v))
    const expMatch = [...attr.exp].some(v => expSet.has(v))
    return acqMatch && expMatch
  })

  return clusters
}
```

---

**Select clusters**

```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-explorer-summaries
//| output: false

ceFilteredIdSet = new Set(ceIdsFiltered)

ceSummaryTable = ceData
  .derive({ is_new: aq.escape(d => d.date_onset >= cutoff ? 1 : 0) })
  .groupby("cluster_id")
  .rollup({
    size: op.count(),
    n_new: d => op.sum(d.is_new),
    subtype: d => op.array_agg_distinct(d.subtype)
  })
  .filter(aq.escape(d => ceFilteredIdSet.has(d.cluster_id)))
  .orderby(aq.desc("cluster_id"))

```

```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-explorer-selection-table

viewof ceSelectedRows = {
  const tableObj = ceSummaryTable.objects()

  if (tableObj.length === 0) {
    const el = noData("No clusters match current filters. Try adjusting the filters above.", {type: "warning"})
    el.value = []
    return el
  }
  return Inputs.table(tableObj, {
    rows: 1000,
    // layout: "fixed",
    required: false,
    value: tableObj.slice(0, 1),
    columns: ["cluster_id", "size", "n_new", "subtype"],
    header: {
      cluster_id: "Cluster ID",
      size: "N",
      n_new: "New",
      subtype: "Subtype"
    },
    width: {
      cluster_id: "25%",
      size: "10%",
      n_new: "15%",
      subtype: "40%"
    },
    index: false
  })
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-explorer-apply-table-selection
//| output: false

ceSelectedIds = {
  if (ceSelectedRows && ceSelectedRows.length > 0) {
    return new Set(ceSelectedRows.map(d => d.cluster_id))
  }
  return new Set()
}

ceCurrentData = ceSelectedIds.size > 0
  ? ceData
    .filter(aq.escape(d => ceSelectedIds.has(d.cluster_id)))
    .orderby('date_onset')
  : ceData.filter(() => false)

ceTotalSamples = ceCurrentData
  .filter(aq.escape(d => d.date_onset >= cutoff))
  .numRows()
```

## Map Column

### Location Map {height=40%}

```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-explorer-map

{
  if (ceSelectedIds.size === 0 || ceCurrentData.numRows() === 0) {
    return noData("No clusters selected.", {height: "300px"})
  }

  const container = html`<div style="width:100%; height:100%; min-height:300px; position:relative"></div>`
  yield container
  // Wait for container render via Promise
  await new Promise(r => new ResizeObserver((_, o) => { o.disconnect(); r() }).observe(container))

  const map = L.map(container, {scrollWheelZoom: false})

  L.tileLayer(
    "https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png?key=" + cartoAPIKey,
      {
      attribution: "&copy; OpenStreetMap Contributors &copy; CARTO",
      maxZoom: 19
    }
  ).addTo(map)


  const countsLookup = {}
  if (ceSelectedIds.size > 0) {
    for (const row of ceCurrentData.objects()) {
      if (row.location) countsLookup[row.location] = (countsLookup[row.location] || 0) + 1
    }
  }

  const maxCount = Math.max(...Object.values(countsLookup), 1) // For legend

  const geo = L.geoJSON(locationsGeo, {
    style: f => geoStyle(f, countsLookup, maxCount),
    onEachFeature: (f, layer) => {
      geoTooltip(f, layer, countsLookup)
      layer.on("click", () =>
        map.fitBounds(layer.getBounds(), {padding: [40, 40], maxZoom: 10})
      )
    }
  }).addTo(map)

  // Check for Locations not in GeoJSON
  const geoNameSet = new Set(locationsGeo.features.map(f => f.properties.name))
  const unmapped = Object.keys(countsLookup)
    .filter(name => countsLookup[name] > 0 && !geoNameSet.has(name))

  if (unmapped.length > 0) {
    const unmappedLabels = unmapped.map(name => `${name} (${countsLookup[name]})`)
    const warning = L.control({position: "topright"})
    warning.onAdd = () => {
      const div = L.DomUtil.create("div")
      div.innerHTML = `
      <div style="background:#FFD200;color:#333;padding:0.5rem 0.75rem;border-radius:4px;font-size:0.8rem;box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.2);max-width:200px">
        <strong>⚠️ Not mapped:</strong> ${unmappedLabels.join(", ")}
      </div>`
      return div
    }
    warning.addTo(map)
  }

  // Handle Bounds: Baseline zoom to features with data, fallback to NSW (where type=location)
  const withData = locationsGeo.features
    .filter(f => countsLookup[f.properties.name] > 0)

  const startBounds = withData.length > 0 ?
    L.geoJSON(withData).getBounds() :
    L.geoJSON(locationsGeo.features.filter(f => f.properties.type === "location")).getBounds()

  const reset = L.control({position: "topleft"})
  reset.onAdd = () => {
    const btn = L.DomUtil.create("button")
    btn.innerHTML = "Reset zoom"
    btn.style.cssText = "padding:4px 8px;cursor:pointer;background:white;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px"
    btn.onclick = (e) => {
      L.DomEvent.stopPropagation(e)
      map.fitBounds(startBounds, {padding: [20, 20], maxZoom: 19})
    }
    return btn
  }
  reset.addTo(map)

  // Add legend
  gradientLegend(map, {max: maxCount, title: "Sequences"})

  let initialFitDone = false;
  const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => {
    map.invalidateSize();
    if (!initialFitDone && container.clientWidth > 100 && container.clientHeight > 100) {
      map.fitBounds(startBounds, {padding: [20, 20], maxZoom: 19});
      initialFitDone = true;
    }
  });
  ro.observe(container);
  invalidation.then(() => ro.disconnect());
}
```

#### Growth curve
```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-explorer-growth
//| expandable: false
{
  if (ceCurrentData.numRows() === 0) {
    return noData("No data to display. Select clusters from table or adjust filters", {height: "200px"})
  }

  const multiCluster = ceSelectedIds.size > 1
  const rows = ceCurrentData.objects()
    .map(d => ({...d, date_onset: new Date(d.date_onset)}))

  if (multiCluster) {
    // Cumulative count per cluster
    const byCluster = {}
    for (const r of rows) {
      if (!byCluster[r.cluster_id]) byCluster[r.cluster_id] = []
      byCluster[r.cluster_id].push(r)
    }
    const plotRows = []
    for (const [cid, crows] of Object.entries(byCluster)) {
      crows.sort((a, b) => a.date_onset - b.date_onset)
      crows.forEach((r, i) => plotRows.push({...r, cumulative: i + 1}))
    }

    return Plot.plot({
      marks: [
        Plot.line(plotRows, {
          x: "date_onset", y: "cumulative",
          stroke: "cluster_id", curve: "step-after"
        }),
        Plot.dot(plotRows, {
          x: "date_onset", y: "cumulative",
          fill: "cluster_id", r: 3, tip: true,
          title: d => `${d.cluster_id}\nCumulative: ${d.cumulative}`
        }),
        Plot.ruleY([0])
      ],
      x: {label: "Date of onset", type: "time"},
      y: {label: "Cumulative samples"},
      color: {legend: true},
      style: { background: "transparent", color: "currentColor" }, // Registers darkmode
      marginLeft: 50
    })
  }

  // Single cluster
  const sorted = rows.sort((a, b) => a.date_onset - b.date_onset)
  const withCum = sorted.map((d, i) => ({...d, cumulative: i + 1}))

  return Plot.plot({
    marks: [
      Plot.line(withCum, {
        x: "date_onset", y: "cumulative",
        curve: "step-after", stroke: "#6C2C91"
      }),
      Plot.dot(withCum, {
        x: "date_onset", y: "cumulative",
        r: 5, fill: "#6C2C91"
      }),
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ],
    x: {label: "Date of onset", type: "time"},
    y: {label: "Cumulative samples", tickFormat: d => Math.floor(d)},
    style: { background: "transparent", color: "currentColor" }, // Registers darkmode
    marginLeft: 50
  })
}
```

#### Timeline
```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-explorer-timeline
//| expandable: false
{
  if (ceCurrentData.numRows() === 0) {
    return noData("No data to display. Select clusters from table or adjust filters", {height: "200px"})
  }

  // Define sort Locations by count and most recent sample
  const locationSummary = ceCurrentData
  .groupby("location")
  .rollup({
    n: op.count(),
    mostRecent: d => op.max(d.date_onset)
  })
  .objects()

const locations = locationSummary
  .sort((left, right) =>
    new Date(right.mostRecent) - new Date(left.mostRecent) ||
    right.n - left.n ||
    left.location.localeCompare(right.location)
  )
  .map(row => row.location)

  // When many locations selected, shink points to fit
  const pointRadius = Math.max(3, 6 - Math.max(0, locations.length - 5))

  const locationBands = locations.map((location, index) => ({
    location,
    fill: (index % 2) - 1 === 0 ? "transparent" : "currentColor"
  }))

  return Plot.plot({
    height: Math.max(300, 56 * locations.length),
    marks: [
      Plot.rectY(locationBands, {
        fy: "location",
        y1: -Infinity,
        y2: Infinity,
        fill: "fill",
        fillOpacity: 0.06
      }),
      Plot.ruleY(locations, {
        fy: d => d,
        y: 0,
        stroke: "currentColor",
        strokeOpacity: 0.18,
        strokeWidth: 1
      }),
      Plot.dot(
        ceCurrentData,
        Plot.dodgeY({
          x: "date_onset",
          fy: "location",
          fill: "infection_stage",
          symbol: "exposure_category",
          r: pointRadius,
          padding: 0.01,
          anchor: "middle",
          tip: true,
          title: d =>
            `Location: ${d.location}\nStage: ${d.infection_stage}\nExposure: ${d.exposure_category}`
        })
      )
    ],
    x: {label: "Date of notification", type: "time"},
    y: {axis: null},
    fy: {
      domain: locations,
      label: null,
      axis: "left",
      padding: 0.12
    },
    color: {legend: true, ...colorScales.infection_stage},
    symbol: {legend: true, ...shapeScales.exposure_category},
    style: {background: "transparent", color: "currentColor"},
    marginLeft: 150,
    marginRight: 20,
    marginBottom: 40,
    marginTop: 30
  })
}
```

#### Birthplace vs acquition location

```{ojs}
//| label: cluster-explorer-birthplace-acquisition
{
  if (ceCurrentData.numRows() === 0) {
    return noData("No data to display.", { height: "200px" })
  }

  const locationOrder = ["Australia", "Overseas", "Unknown/Other"]

  // Why am I counting insted ofusing op.count()? It's a patch...
  // I found that in the case whwere all values were one location for
  // both birth_location and acquisition_location, then op.count() would
  // return a strange value, like 955 for a cluster of 3.
  const countByPair = new Map()
  for (const row of ceCurrentData.objects()) {
    const acquisition = row.acquisition_location
    const birth = row.birth_location
    const key = JSON.stringify([acquisition, birth])
    countByPair.set(key, (countByPair.get(key) ?? 0) + 1)
  }

  const heatmapData = locationOrder.flatMap(acquisition_location =>
    locationOrder.map(birth_location => ({
      acquisition_location,
      birth_location,
      count: countByPair.get(
        JSON.stringify([acquisition_location, birth_location])
      ) ?? 0 // Fallback to 0 if no count exists for this pair
    }))
  )

  return Plot.plot({
    padding: 0,
    color: { scheme: "blues", legend: false },
    marks: [
      Plot.cell(heatmapData, {
        x: "acquisition_location",
        y: "birth_location",
        fill: "count",
        inset: 0.5,
        title: d =>
          `Acquisition: ${d.acquisition_location}\nBirth location: ${d.birth_location}\nCount: ${d.count}`
      }),
      Plot.text(heatmapData, {
        x: "acquisition_location",
        y: "birth_location",
        text: "count",
        fill: "orange"
      })
    ],
    x: {
      label: "Acquisition location",
      tickRotate: -35,
      domain: locationOrder
    },
    y: {
      label: "Birth location",
      tickROtate: -35,
      domain: locationOrder
    },
    style: { background: "transparent", color: "currentColor" },
    marginBottom: 70,
    marginLeft: 70
  })
}
```
